steps.title: Place the frame
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as esp2026_seat_set.iam.
Place frame.iam (sub-assembly 1: legs, track fittings, beam tubes, collars, spreaders, end caps, baggage bar) and Place Grounded.
steps.note: Build each sub-assembly first (see its own Build steps), then place them here. The frame is the base.

steps.title: Seat pans
actions: Place seat_pan.iam (sub-assembly 2) on the beam tubes of the middle seat: Mate the underside of the diaphragm to the tops of the tubes and Flush its centre plane with the seat centre line.
Pattern > Rectangular: 3 along X, 500 mm apart, centred.

steps.title: Seat backs
actions: Place seat_back.iam (sub-assembly 3) for each seat. Line up the pivot lugs with the holes in the spreaders.
Add an Angle constraint of 12 degrees between each back and the vertical (upright).

steps.title: Back pivot pins
actions: Insert back_pivot_pin.ipt through the two middle spreaders and end_pivot_pin.ipt through the end ones, through the lugs of the backs.
steps.note: Each back turns on these pins: upright at 12 degrees from vertical, reclined at 17.

steps.title: Recline locks
actions: Place recline_lock.iam (sub-assembly 4) for each seat: Mate the bracket to the underside of the front tube, 204 mm right of the seat centre, and pin the rod eye to the lever on the back shell.
steps.note: Pressing the recline button opens the lock; the passenger leans back and the rod slides in 9 mm.

steps.title: Armrests
actions: Place armrest.iam (sub-assembly 5) on the first spreader: Insert its pivot pin through the spreader.
Pattern: 4 along X, 500 mm apart. Suppress the button on the left hand armrest (it has none).
steps.note: Each armrest lifts 90 degrees; the end ones let a passenger transfer from an aisle wheelchair.

steps.title: Lap belts
actions: Place lap_belt.iam (sub-assembly 6) on the middle seat: bolt each anchor to its spreader (M10 bolts from Content Center). Pattern: 3 along X, 500 mm apart.

steps.title: Life vest pouches
actions: Place life_vest_pouch.iam (sub-assembly 7) under the middle seat: Mate its top to the underside of the beam tubes. Pattern: 3 along X, 500 mm apart.
Inspect tab > Interference > Analyze Interference upright, reclined, with the trays down and the armrests up: no parts overlap. Save.
steps.note: All 128 parts are now in place: 7 sub-assemblies plus the 4 pivot pins.
